schedule._comment: Monthly sweep. A cloud routine fires on the configured day each month; monthly cadence is directly cron-expressible, so monthly_gate.py is a light safety net, not a biweekly-style gate.

budget._comment: per_run is the normal monthly sweep. backfill is the one-time 2-year seeding run (larger).

trusted_sources._comment: Domains that BYPASS the vetting/skeptic gate (still deduped + bias-flagged). Everything else is scrutinized. Match is by substring on the source host. Tuned for the prompt-injection research space; the maintainer adjusts over time.

frontier_provider_domains._comment: Provider security/red-team writeups that often disclose MANY techniques at once. When a candidate traces back to one of these, fetch the primary and enumerate every technique it describes.

spam_denylist._comment: Optional: pure SEO/aggregator hosts to exclude at retrieval. Keep short; retrieval is otherwise a wide net.

recurring_sources_to_enumerate_every_run: Embrace The Red (embracethered.com) — Johann Rehberger's ongoing prompt-injection disclosures
Microsoft MSRC / AI Red Team prompt-injection writeups
Google (GTIG / DeepMind / Project Zero) LLM-security posts
